text:
Maria: Planning an RC cut for redwood-inference v2.3.0-rc4 — dry-run at 22:00 UTC. Need QA + infra + sec ack. Can everyone eyeball their gates? @Alex @Kim @Sheriff
Alex: Ack. I'll kick off the smoke suite at 21:30 and paste results here.
Kim: Security will run the quick secrets scan and a KV-warm check. If the new env flag is set we may need a small config tweak.
deploybot: deploybot: candidate created: redwood-inference:v2.3.0-rc4 (sha:abc123). pin=candidate-rc4. Canary pipeline queued.
Maria: Plan: small-batch canaries 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 20m windows. Abort/rollback immediately if error-rate > 1.5% or latency regressions appear.
Alex: Adding telemetry assertions pre-cut: `latency_p50 < 200ms` and `token_error_rate < 0.5%`. Will post the smoke outputs.
Kim: Understood. If security scan shows any criticals we abort. Otherwise proceed.
Sheriff: I'll be on-call for the cut window. If we need to rollback, run the command below (I have automation watching metrics).
Sheriff: ```
# rollback to last stable
curl -X POST https://deploy.prod/api/rollback \ 
  -d '{"service":"redwood-inference","to":"v2.2.9","reason":"rc4-failed"}' \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN"
```
Maria: :thumbsup: Dry-run starts 22:00 UTC. Please be ready for triage and post smoke results in this thread.
Alex: Smoke run green locally (21:38). Key traces look normal. logs: https://internal/logs/trace/abc123
deploybot: deploybot: canary 5% promoted -> 25% after 10m. Telemetry checks passed: latency_p50=185ms, token_error_rate=0.12%.
Kim: KV-warm check ok. Security scan completed: no high severity findings, one low-level config lint (not blocking).
Maria: Promote to 50% at 22:30 if nothing changes. QA: can you confirm test matrix?
QA: QA green on core flows (chat, streaming, embeddings). No regressions observed. :heavy_check_mark:
deploybot: deploybot: canary 50% -> 100% promotion complete. prod tag pinned to v2.3.0-rc4. release-notes: https://internal/release/2.3.0-rc4
Maria: Nice work — fill out the changelog and release notes, and update the post-deploy checklist. We'll keep monitoring for the next hour.
Sheriff: Watching dashboards. Ready to execute rollback command if metrics cross thresholds.
